lines.en: label nodokalibrary5:
scene black
{i}A fool sees not the same tree that a wise man sees.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}愚人所见的树，与智者所见的并非同一棵。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He whose face gives no light, shall never become a star.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}脸上不发光的人，永远成不了星。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Eternity is in love with the productions of time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}永恒爱上了时间的造物。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The busy bee has no time for sorrow.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}忙碌的蜜蜂没有时间悲伤。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The hours of folly are measured by the clock, but of wisdom: no clock can measure.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}愚昧的时光由时钟来计量；但智慧：没有任何时钟能够计量。{/i}

lines.en: {i}- William Blake (1757 - Whenever he died)
lines.zh: {i}——William Blake（1757—他死的那年的某个时候）{/i}

lines.en: Some people have danced with tragedy while others do not know how to dance at all.
lines.zh: 有些人曾与悲剧共舞，而另一些人根本不知道怎么跳舞。

lines.en: And somewhere between those two dancers, there is a place that resembles ours.
lines.zh: 而在这两个舞者之间的某处，有一个酷似我们所在之处的地方。

lines.en: You likely won’t ever see it.
lines.zh: 你大概永远看不到它。

lines.en: But some have.
lines.zh: 但有些人看到过。

lines.en: And you likely won’t ever see them either.
lines.zh: 而那些人，你大概也永远看不到。

lines.en: Because their world faces a different direction than ours.
lines.zh: 因为他们的世界，面朝的方向跟我们的不同。

lines.en: I hope you’re happy, wherever you are.
lines.zh: 我希望你幸福，无论你在哪儿。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib1
: Good afternoon, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 下午好，Sensei。

lines.en: : Your timing is quite good today. I was just starting to get bored.
lines.zh: : 你今天来得挺是时候。我正开始觉得无聊。

lines.en: : Well you certainly look relaxed, if not anything else.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别的先不说，你看起来确实挺放松的。

lines.en: : This library has no couch, so I needed to create my own out of a metal chair and an annoyingly elevated desk.
lines.zh: : 这间图书馆没有沙发，所以我只好用一把金属椅和一张高得恼人的桌子给自己搭一个。

lines.en: : I give it a 5/10 for comfort and 7/10 for accessibility.
lines.zh: : 舒适度我给 5/10，便利性 7/10。

lines.en: : Is this how bored you are? Resorting to rating the objects of the library?
lines.zh: : 你是有多无聊？沦落到给图书馆里的物品打分？

lines.en: : Do you want to know {i}your{/i} rating?
lines.zh: : 你想知道{i}你的{/i}分数吗？

lines.en: : I don't. I’m pretty sure it would make me self-conscious if it was low.
lines.zh: : 不想。我很确定分数要是低了，我会变得不自在。

lines.en: : Does my opinion matter that much to you?
lines.zh: : 我的意见对你来说那么重要吗？

lines.en: : It doesn’t...{i}not{/i} matter?
lines.zh: : 也{i}不是{/i}……不重要？

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : So, how should the two of us kill time today without Futaba around to stare at?
lines.zh: : 那么，今天 Futaba 不在、没得看，我们两个该怎么消磨时间？

lines.en: : We could just stare at each other, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我猜，我们可以就这么互相看着。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, we could leave this place altogether and find something else to do.
lines.zh: : 或者，我们也可以干脆离开这个地方，去找点别的做。

lines.en: : Are you allowed to leave right now? I thought you were taking over for Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你现在能走吗？我还以为你在替 Futaba 值班？

lines.en: : Yes. I’m taking over for her volunteer position in a[school] library over the weekend, when barely anyone visits.
lines.zh: : 是的。我周末替她在一所 [school] 图书馆做志愿者，那时候几乎没人来。

lines.en: : I think I can get away with leaving a little early if I have prior engagements.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我事先有约，早走一会儿应该没关系。

lines.en: : It’s not really a prior engagement if we make it right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我们是现在才约定的，那也算不上事先有约。

lines.en: : No, but the books don’t know that.
lines.zh: : 不算，可书不知道啊。

lines.en: : The books don’t know anything. They are books.
lines.zh: : 书什么都不知道。它们是书。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib2
: Did you hear that, Hamlet? Sensei thinks you’re worthless.
lines.zh: : 听见了吗，Hamlet？Sensei 觉得你一文不值。

lines.en: : He bites his thumb at you.
lines.zh: : 他朝你咬大拇指呢。

lines.en: : Hey. That line isn’t even from Hamlet.
lines.zh: : 嘿。那句台词根本不是出自 Hamlet。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib3
: It’s not. But the phrase carries the same meaning and was completely comprehensible in context, correct?
lines.zh: : 确实不是。但这个说法意思一样，而且在语境里完全能听懂，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you quarrel, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你要吵架吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Quarrel, sir? No sir.
lines.zh: : 吵架吗，先生？不，先生。

lines.en: : As much as I'd like to continue, I don’t really remember anything else from that play.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想继续，但那部戏别的我都不记得了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m not much of an actor anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我也不怎么擅长演戏。

lines.en: : I don’t even really like plays. I’m just reading this because it was the first thing I picked up.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不怎么喜欢戏剧。我读这本只是因为它是我第一本拿起来的。

lines.en: : This[school] is fine, but the library is small and its selection is entirely generic.
lines.zh: : 这所 [school] 还行，但图书馆很小，藏书也全是些泛泛之作。

lines.en: : My heart aches for all of those poor books stuck in that sink hole.
lines.zh: : 我为所有困在那个沉坑里的可怜书本感到心疼。

lines.en: : Oh, here’s an idea. How would you like to venture to the ruins of my old[school] and throw yourself into an abyss?
lines.zh: : 哦，我有个主意。你愿意跟我一起去我以前那所 [school] 的废墟，然后纵身跳进一个深渊吗？

lines.en: : I would not like to do that at all. It sounds horrible and dangerous.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不想。听起来又可怕又危险。

lines.en: : Then tie a rope around me and lower me down so I can at least pick up a few things I haven’t already read.
lines.zh: : 那就在我身上绑根绳子，把我放下去，好让我至少能捡几本我还没读过的。

lines.en: : If I ever tie a rope around you, it will be for significantly less wholesome reasons.
lines.zh: : 如果我真要在你身上绑根绳子，那理由可远没有这么正派。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib4
: Bondage fan?
lines.zh: : 绑缚爱好者？

lines.en: : Not really, but pretty much everyone is fine with bondage if it’s just rope.
lines.zh: : 不算，不过只要是绳子，差不多每个人都能接受绑缚吧。

lines.en: : I think.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧。

lines.en: : I don’t really know, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实我也不太确定。

lines.en: : Handcuffs?
lines.zh: : 手铐呢？

lines.en: : Sure. I know where to buy some, too.
lines.zh: : 可以。我还知道哪儿能买到。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I wouldn’t be allowed to actually purchase them, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我很确定我实际上不被允许买。

lines.en: : Did you somehow manage to get yourself banned from a sex shop, Sensei? That’s so depressing.
lines.zh: : 你是怎么被情趣用品店拉黑的，Sensei？那可太惨了。

lines.en: : No. I just...know someone who works there.
lines.zh: : 不是。我只是……认识一个在那儿工作的人。

lines.en: : Someone I can meet?
lines.zh: : 我能见的人？

lines.en: : Someone you’ve already met.
lines.zh: : 你已经见过的人。

lines.en: : Is it the tiny girl with the black hair who sits in the back of the classroom?
lines.zh: : 是坐在教室后面那个小小的、黑头发的女孩吗？

lines.en: : Are you just {i}always{/i} going to guess Sana whenever I mention anything remotely sexual involving literally anyone?
lines.zh: : 只要我提到任何跟任何人有关的、哪怕沾点性的事，你就{i}永远{/i}猜 Sana 吗？

lines.en: : I’m telling you, Sensei. She’s a freak. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说，Sensei。她是个变态。我能感觉到。

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
Well she...definitely would not be the only one in her family like that.
lines.zh: 嗯，她……在她家里肯定不是唯一一个那样的。

lines.en: : I...don’t think that’s true. But if that’s what you want to think, feel free.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得那是真的。不过如果你想那么想，随你。

lines.en: : Speaking of “things that I think,” I’d like to reiterate and reintroduce the idea of us getting out of here.
lines.zh: : 说到「我想的事」，我想重申并再次提出：我们离开这儿吧。

lines.en: : I haven’t seen a non-Sensei soul in hours. There is absolutely no downside to the two of us going on a little adventure.
lines.zh: : 我已经好几个小时没见过一个非 Sensei 的活人了。我们俩出去小小地冒险一下，绝对没有任何坏处。

lines.en: : An adventure to where? I’m fine with going out to lunch or something, but if you’re trying to drag me into a janitor’s closet...
lines.zh: : 去哪儿冒险？出去吃个午饭什么的我没意见，但如果你想把我拖进保洁柜……

lines.en: : Well, that’s even better.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就更好了。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib5
: Hmm...no. Flirting is fun but I think we should limit things to just extremely suggestive talking for now.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不。调情是很有趣，但我觉得我们现在应该把范围限制在「极具暗示性的谈话」上。

lines.en: : Just think of how great the payoff will be if we build up the tension a little more.
lines.zh: : 想想看，要是我们把张力再堆高一点，最后的回报会有多大。

lines.en: : And you were accusing {i}me{/i} of leading people on.
lines.zh: : 而你刚才还在指控{i}我{/i}吊着别人。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib6
: Here, take a Nodoka point. Does that make you feel any better?
lines.zh: : 给，拿一个 Nodoka 点数。这让你好受点了吗？

lines.en: : Just one? I thought they only came in multiples of fives?
lines.zh: : 就一个？我还以为它们只会五个五个地出现？

lines.en: : They come in whatever amount I want them to come in. I’m in charge, remember?
lines.zh: : 我想让它们出现多少，它们就出现多少。我说了算，记得吗？

lines.en: : That’s one hell of a double standard, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 这双重标准可真够可以的，Nodoka。

lines.en: : I’m one hell of a girl, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我这个姑娘也够可以的，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka grips her skirt as she moves her legs off of the desk and prevents me from being able to look up it because she is evil.
lines.zh: Nodoka 在把腿从桌上放下来时攥住自己的裙子，害我没法往上看——因为她是个恶魔。

lines.en: She puts Hamlet back on his shelf before the poison ever finds its way into his veins and he proceeds to live a long and happy life with Ophelia.
lines.zh: 她把 Hamlet 放回了他的书架，趁毒药还没流进他的血管，让他得以跟 Ophelia 一起过上长寿而幸福的生活。

lines.en: Until someone else decides to open the book, that is.
lines.zh: 至少在别人决定翻开那本书之前是这样。

lines.en: I can’t help but wonder how many other things there are in this world that are better left unfinished or unopened as we make our way out of the library and into the halls of the[school].
lines.zh: 当我们走出图书馆、走进这所 [school] 的走廊时，我忍不住想，这世上还有多少别的东西，也是不开、不读完更好的。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib7
: It feels like just the other day we were walking on the bridge like this.
lines.zh: : 感觉就像我们前几天才这样走在桥上一样。

lines.en: : That kind of {i}was{/i} just the other day, though.
lines.zh: : 那{i}确实{/i}就是前几天的事。

lines.en: : I suppose that’s true.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。

lines.en: : Has your opinion of me changed at all within that time frame?
lines.zh: : 在那段时间里，你对我的看法有改变吗？

lines.en: : I’m a little more worried about you as a person than I was back then.
lines.zh: : 作为一个人，我比那时更担心你了。

lines.en: : Worried? Why?
lines.zh: : 担心？为什么？

lines.en: : Well, maybe “worried” isn’t the right word. But I’m starting to think you’re capable of doing a lot more than you actually...want to do? Does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许「担心」不是恰当的词。但我开始觉得，你有能力做到的，远比你实际……想做的要多？这么说你懂吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太懂，不懂。

lines.en: : Then let me try explaining it like this-
lines.zh: : 那我换个方式解释——

lines.en: : I think there are two Nodokas.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有两个 Nodoka。

lines.en: : That would make an exciting threesome.
lines.zh: : 那会是一场刺激的三人行。

lines.en: : It would, yes.
lines.zh: : 是的，会的。

lines.en: : But what I was getting at is that one of those Nodokas wants to be suggestive and flirty all day...
lines.zh: : 但我想说的是，其中一个 Nodoka 想整天充满暗示、调情个不停……

lines.en: : While the other one cares more about “tension” and...seemingly wants me to create the world’s largest consensual harem.
lines.zh: : 而另一个更在意「张力」，而且……似乎想让我建一个世界上最大的、双方自愿的后宫。

lines.en: : You’re forgetting about the Nodoka who wants you all to herself.
lines.zh: : 你忘了那个想把你占为己有的 Nodoka。

lines.en: : And the Nodoka who doesn’t want you at all.
lines.zh: : 还有那个根本不想要你的 Nodoka。

lines.en: : So many Nodokas, so little time.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 那么多，时间那么少。

lines.en: : Which one is real, though?
lines.zh: : 可哪个是真的？

lines.en: : All of them? None of them? Who knows?
lines.zh: : 全都是？全都不是？谁知道呢？

lines.en: : I would imagine you do.
lines.zh: : 我想你应该知道。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib8
: Nope.
: I don’t really care to find out either.
lines.zh: : 我也不太想去弄清楚。

lines.en: : I just want to make memories while I still can.
lines.zh: : 我只是想趁还能的时候，多制造一些回忆。

lines.en: : Good memories, bad memories, sad memories, passionate memories.
lines.zh: : 好的回忆，坏的回忆，悲伤的回忆，炽烈的回忆。

lines.en: : Memories of anything and everything.
lines.zh: : 任何事、一切事的回忆。

lines.en: : If I feel every feeling the world has to offer, I’ll have an unlimited library of experiences to pull from and be inspired by.
lines.zh: : 如果我感受过这世上能提供的每一种感受，我就会有一座取之不尽的经验图书馆，可以从中汲取、获得灵感。

lines.en: : And I’m not just talking about sexual stuff right now either.
lines.zh: : 而且我说的还不只是性方面的东西。

lines.en: : I...didn’t think you were.
lines.zh: : 我……没觉得你在说那个。

lines.en: : Okay, good.
lines.zh: : 好，那就好。

lines.en: : I did have a sex dream about you last night, though, just for the record.
lines.zh: : 不过声明一下，我昨晚做了个关于你的春梦。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib9
: The point is, you can’t figure out which Nodoka is the “real” Nodoka because she is all of those things.
lines.zh: : 重点是，你搞不清哪个 Nodoka 才是「真的」Nodoka，因为她同时是所有这些东西。

lines.en: : She’s just a girl. Not some genius or prodigy or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 她只是个女孩。不是什么天才或神童之类的。

lines.en: : Don’t you have the highest test scores in all of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你不是全 Kumon-mi 考试分数最高的吗？

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib10
: Okay, so maybe I {i}am{/i} a genius. But anyone can be a genius if they spend their entire life just...living other lives via literature.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许我{i}确实{/i}是个天才。但只要一个人把整个人生都花在……借文学过别人的生活上，谁都能成为天才。

lines.en: : I said before that I’m not an actor, but one of the things I enjoy most of all is imagining how I would feel as someone else...Someone who isn't real.
lines.zh: : 我说过我不擅长演戏，但我最喜欢的事情之一，就是想象自己作为另一个人会有怎样的感受……一个并不真实存在的人。

lines.en: : Or what I would do in their shoes, if only I could fit into them.
lines.zh: : 或者，如果我能穿上他们的鞋，我会怎么做。

lines.en: : And yes, the answer to that question is typically declothing every female character and strapping them to sex machines-
lines.zh: : 而且是的，那个问题的答案通常是把每一个女性角色脱光、绑到性机器上——

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib11
: And yes, sometimes I must hook {i}myself{/i} up to those sex machines to truly understand what it means to feel-
lines.zh: : 而且是的，有时候我必须把{i}自己{/i}也接到那些性机器上，才能真正理解「感受」意味着什么——

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
scene nodokasecondlib12
: But the second I close the book, I’m just Nodoka again.
lines.zh: : 但我一合上书，就又只是 Nodoka 了。

lines.en: : And everything turns gray.
lines.zh: : 然后一切都变成灰色。

lines.en: : And I have to go out and find new colors to fill everything back in.
lines.zh: : 然后我必须出去，找到新的颜色，把一切重新填满。

lines.en: : Life would have been easier if I wasn’t printed as a picture book.
lines.zh: : 如果我不是被印成一本图画书，人生会轻松得多。

lines.en: : The main reason so many people fall in love with fiction is because they’re searching for something they can’t obtain on their own.
lines.zh: : 那么多人爱上虚构作品，主要是因为他们寻找的东西，是自己无法独自获得的。

lines.en: : But there are also people who fall in love with it simply because there isn’t anything else to do.
lines.zh: : 但也有一些人爱上它，仅仅是因为没有别的事可做。

lines.en: : People who get so bored of not being able to feel anything that they allow themselves to fall into those who can.
lines.zh: : 那些人无聊到感受不到任何东西，于是任由自己坠入那些能感受的人之中。

lines.en: : I kind of hate reading, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实我有点讨厌阅读。

lines.en: : It’s time consuming...you can’t do it in the dark...and the memories you get out of it can barely be called memories at all since they aren’t your own.
lines.zh: : 它耗时……在黑暗里没法读……而且从中得到的记忆，几乎不能被称为记忆，因为它们不是你自己的。

lines.en: : But the things I love about it always manage to outweigh those somehow.
lines.zh: : 但不知怎么，我热爱它的那些部分，总是能压过这些。

lines.en: : Even when I wish they wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 即使有时候我真希望它们别压过。

lines.en: : You don’t sound like a picture book at all, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 你听起来一点也不像图画书，Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib13
: Huh?
: You’re more like a...and forgive me in advance if this sounds childish-
lines.zh: : 你更像一本……先提前原谅我这么说，可能有点幼稚——

lines.en: : But you’re more like a coloring book.
lines.zh: : 但你更像一本涂色书。

lines.en: : A really advanced one with a lot of difficult drawings that...requires special attention and weird colors like chartreuse and mauve.
lines.zh: : 一本非常高级的、里面有很多难画的图……需要特别的用心，还有 chartreuse 和 mauve 之类奇怪的颜色。

lines.en: : And you’re just waiting to be filled in.
lines.zh: : 而你就等着被填满。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib14
: It’s back.
lines.zh: : 它回来了。

lines.en: : Hm? What is?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么回来了？

lines.en: : The color.
lines.zh: : 颜色。

lines.en: : It’s been gone for days.
lines.zh: : 它已经消失好几天了。

lines.en: : And there’s no chartreuse or mauve anywhere to be found...
lines.zh: : 可到处都找不到 chartreuse，也找不到 mauve……

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib15
: Looks like you were wrong, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 看来你错了，Sensei。

lines.en: : You just haven’t gotten to the page with all of the weird colors yet. You’re only in the beginning of the book.
lines.zh: : 你只是还没翻到有那些奇怪颜色的那一页。你还在书的开头。

lines.en: : So the hardest is yet to come?
lines.zh: : 所以最难的还在后头？

lines.en: : That depends. You’re not battling any really intense trauma or something, are you?
lines.zh: : 那得看情况。你不是在跟什么特别严重的心理创伤搏斗之类的吧？

lines.en: : Is that really something you’re supposed to be asking someone?
lines.zh: : 这种事是你该问别人的吗？

lines.en: : Supposed to? No. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 该不该？不。大概不该。

lines.en: : But I think we’re already at the level where we can start sharing things like that with one another.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得我们已经到了可以开始互相分享这种事的阶段了。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib16
: Hmm...I suppose we are.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想是的。

lines.en: : We’re out of the library now, but I think I’m going to carry on with my newfound hobby of rating things and give my personal trauma a solid 5/10.
lines.zh: : 我们已经走出图书馆了，但我想继续我新发现的「给东西打分」的爱好，给自己的个人创伤打个扎实的 5/10。

lines.en: : Nothing unmanageable, but nothing overwhelmingly tragic like witnessing a friend jump to her death or being mauled by a rhino.
lines.zh: : 没什么无法应付的，但也没有什么极度悲惨的事，比如目睹一个朋友跳楼身亡，或者被犀牛撞伤。

lines.en: : What kind of world do you live in where “being mauled by a rhino” is the second thing that comes to mind when measuring trauma?
lines.zh: : 你到底活在什么样的世界里，衡量创伤时第二个想到的居然是「被犀牛撞伤」？

lines.en: : One that’s sure to get a lot more colorful from this point on.
lines.zh: : 一个从现在开始一定会变得多彩得多的世界。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib17
: Or not.
lines.zh: : 也可能不会。

lines.en: : For all we know, the two of us could grow to hate each other over something small like...taking the last piece of garlic bread.
lines.zh: : 说不定我们俩会因为什么小事而渐渐恨上对方，比如……吃掉最后一块蒜香面包。

lines.en: : To prevent that hate from ever spawning, I hereby give you permanent permission to finish off any and all bread that we eat together in the future.
lines.zh: : 为了防止那份恨意滋生，我在此永久授予你一项权利：今后我们一起吃的任何面包，剩下的都归你。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Cause I really like bread and eating more of it all the time will make me fat.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为我真的很喜欢面包，一直多吃会让我变胖。

lines.en: : I won’t be able to fit into the janitor’s closet anymore.
lines.zh: : 我就再也挤不进那间保洁柜了。

lines.en: : We can just find a bigger closet, then.
lines.zh: : 那我们找间更大的柜子就行。

lines.en: : I’m not worried.
lines.zh: : 我不担心。

lines.en: scene nodokasecondlib18
: Neither am I.
lines.zh: : 我也不担心。

lines.en: : If music be the food of love, play on.
lines.zh: : 若音乐是爱的食粮，那就继续奏下去吧。

lines.en: : Here’s to the rest of our time together...which is sure to be full of confusion, misunderstandings, and handjobs in the locker room.
lines.zh: : 敬我们剩下的共处时光……那一定会充满困惑、误解，以及更衣室里的手活。

lines.en: : I’ve never seen someone say “handjobs” with such a hopeful look on their face before.
lines.zh: : 我从没见过有人带着这么充满希望的表情说出「手活」这两个字。

lines.en: : Then let us take this moment and lock it away in our collage of colors as just one of many memories the two of us will make together.
lines.zh: : 那么，就让我们把这一刻锁进我们的色彩拼贴画里，当作我们俩将共同制造的众多回忆之一。

lines.en: : Hooray for sinkholes.
lines.zh: : 沉坑万岁。

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : Hooray for sinkholes.
lines.zh: : 沉坑万岁。
